zh-CN.title: 投稿创建流程焕新
items: 选择官方或运营后会直接进入草稿会话，并在会话内完成投稿命名
首条投稿消息现在与后续消息拥有一致的输入、展示和发送体验

en.title: A smoother submission flow
items: Choosing an official or operator now opens a draft conversation where you name the submission
The first submission message now uses the same composer, appearance, and sending flow as later messages
